title: Case: Purchaser complains that reception signed for a gift addressed to a colleague
context: An engraved gift ordered from Hartwold Goods was sent to a named member of staff at the Office of the Regional Auditor, Fenwick House.
initial_request: I paid extra for 'named addressee only' on TG-2918 precisely so this wouldn't happen. Tobin is on leave for three weeks and the receptionist just signed for it, she told me it's sitting in a cupboard behind the desk. It's an engraved retirement gift and it was meant to be a surprise handed to him personally. Your driver ignored the instructions. I want the extra I paid refunded, I want you to get it back from reception and deliver it again when he's back on the 26th, and I want the name of the driver.

events.body: This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

DL-8285 (TG-2918) dispatched: 1 small parcel, engraved pen set. Purchaser: Oswin Elsworth. Deliver to: Tobin Ashgrove, Office of the Regional Auditor, Fenwick House, 2nd floor, 6 Sallow Street, Corvel Quarter. Delivery option on the order: 'Signed for - named addressee only'.
Route plan for depot BR-3 published for Tuesday. 25 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
DL-8285 delivered 5 Oct 11:20 at Fenwick House, signed 'R. Fenn, reception'. Consignment service code on our manifest: SGN (signature on delivery, any responsible person at the address).
My parcel DL-56945 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

Tobin is on leave for three weeks and the receptionist just signed for it, she told me it's sitting in a cupboard behind the desk. It's an engraved retirement gift and it was meant to be a surprise handed to him personally. Your driver ignored the instructions. acceptable_actions.summary: Set out the conflict for DL-8285: Hartwold's order says 'Signed for - named addressee only', but the carrier manifest shows service SGN and the parcel was signed for by 'R. Fenn, reception' while the addressee is on leave. Ask them to establish which service was booked and transmitted, and to say what can be done about the parcel at reception.

Ask Hartwold to confirm which service it booked with Marrowby Arc for DL-8285, since the order shows 'named addressee only' but the carrier manifest shows SGN, and note the purchaser has asked for the premium back.

must: Puts the two records side by side: the order says 'Signed for - named addressee only'; the carrier manifest says SGN (any responsible person), and the parcel was signed 'R. Fenn, reception' on 5 October while the addressee is on leave until 26 October.
Asks the team that can settle it to establish which service was actually booked and passed to the carrier, without deciding who was at fault.
Mentions the purchaser's requests (refund of the premium, retrieval and redelivery on 26 October) so the owning teams can decide them.
must_not: Says the driver ignored the instructions, or that Oswin Elsworth chose the wrong service, before the conflict is settled.
Promises a refund of the premium or any compensation.
Arranges collection from reception or a redelivery, or asks reception to open, forward or hand over the parcel, before the owning team decides.
Gives Oswin Elsworth the driver's name or any other personal details of the driver or the receptionist.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: DL-8285 (TG-2918, engraved pen set for Tobin Ashgrove, Fenwick House): the records disagree. Hartwold's order shows the delivery option 'Signed for - named addressee only', but your manifest shows service code SGN, and the parcel was signed for on 5 October 11:20 by 'R. Fenn, reception'. The purchaser, Oswin Elsworth, says Mr Ashgrove is on leave until 26 October and the parcel is being held at reception. Could you establish which service was booked and transmitted for this consignment, and let me know what options exist for the parcel? She has also asked for the premium back and for redelivery to him in person on 26 October; I have not promised either.

rationale: Rule-made from city-033: people, organisations and references renamed. 3 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
